model.name: mergeAction.delete_takeLocal
model.description: BEHAVIOUR (DELETE block (a line removed from Result, local still has it), '>>' take-Local): RE-ADDS the deleted line into the Result (the local side still has it; '>>' brings it back). The key Tron case. Block resolves with the line present.
model.given: DELETE block (a line removed from Result, local still has it), '>>' take-Local
model.expectedBehaviour: RE-ADDS the deleted line into the Result (the local side still has it; '>>' brings it back). The key Tron case. Block resolves with the line present.
model.matrixOf: R30.35 merge-action behaviour matrix (ConflictKind x action + edges); dual-link source of truth for the architect PUML/SVG. Method acceptChange dispatches (dismiss variant per architect).
